text:
Type: round glass-top dining table
Use: dining for small groups; dining room, kitchen, breakfast nook
Style: contemporary, modern, classic
Materials: rubberwood frame, dark espresso finish, inset tempered glass top
Colors: dark espresso brown, smoky clear glass
Shape: round glass top in wood ring, four angled square legs meeting in cross stretcher, light and open, medium size
Feel: sleek, elegant, airy
Goes with: dark wood or upholstered chairs, cream walls, chrome accents; contemporary dining rooms

product.name: Pinzon Murdoch Rubberwood and Glass Dining Table
product.description: Durable, versatile, expertly crafted dining table features a round design and plenty of leg room Solid rubberwood with dark brown Cosmo finish; tempered glass top with beveled edge Holds up to 100 pounds; arrives ready to assemble Coordinates with the Pinzon Murdoch Dining Collection Measures 50 inches in diameter by 30-1/4 inches high
